name: Meats to Orgrimmar
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend.  Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar.  Will you deliver the meat for me?

The fastest way to Orgrimmar is on a wind rider.  Take the meats to the Crossroads wind rider master, Devrak, and speak with him about transport to Orgrimmar.
narrative.objectives: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have to get this meat to Orgrimmar? That is no problem. For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.
narrative.requestItemsText: You need to get somewhere fast? Then you're talking to the right orc!

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 10, 1,890 XP in all.

quests.name: Meats to Orgrimmar
quests.objectiveText: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Ride to Orgrimmar
quests.objectiveText: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
quests.objectiveText: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Return to the Crossroads
quests.objectiveText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.
